skill.name: file-organizer
skill.description: Organizes folders, reviews duplicate candidates, and proposes safer structures before file changes. Use for Downloads cleanup, archives, and project restructuring.
skill.summary: Guides careful folder cleanup, duplicate review, and approved file organization.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Messy folders make files hard to find and duplicate content wastes storage. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through analysis, planning, and approved organization steps.
actual_capabilities: Reviews directory structure, file types, sizes, dates, and visible organization issues.
Groups files by type, purpose, activity status, project, or date.
Identifies duplicate candidates by hash, filename, and file size when requested.
Builds an approval plan before folder creation, moves, renames, or deletion.
Provides completion summaries, new structure notes, and maintenance routines.
limitations: It depends on user approval before destructive changes.
It cannot guarantee semantic classification for ambiguous personal or work files.
Large directories may require staged review to avoid slow commands.
It does not replace backups or version control for important files.

use_cases.title: Clean a Downloads Folder
use_cases.description: Sort documents, images, archives, and temporary files into clear destinations after review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Project Archive
use_cases.description: Separate active work, references, old deliverables, and archive candidates before storage.

use_cases.title: Review Duplicate Files
use_cases.description: Find duplicate candidates, compare useful metadata, and decide which copies to keep.

prompt_templates.title: Organize One Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me organize my Downloads folder. Ask questions first, then inspect the folder and propose a conservative plan.

prompt_templates.title: Find Duplicate Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Find likely duplicates in my Documents folder. Show each duplicate group, recommend what to keep, and wait before deleting anything.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Project Archive
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an organization plan for this project archive. Separate active files, references, media, and old deliverables. Flag uncertain files for review.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Guarded Cleanup
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a comprehensive cleanup for this home directory. Avoid current projects and sensitive folders. Include logging, conflict handling, and an undo approach.

output_examples.input: User asks to clean a crowded Downloads folder.
output_examples.output: A current-state summary, proposed folders, files needing decisions, and a yes or modify approval question.

output_examples.input: User asks to find duplicate documents.
output_examples.output: Duplicate groups with file names, sizes, dates, keep recommendations, and a deletion confirmation request.

output_examples.input: User asks for a cleanup completion summary.
output_examples.output: Counts of organized files, created folders, archived items, unresolved decisions, and maintenance reminders.

best_practices: Back up important folders before large moves or deletion.
Review the proposed plan before approving file changes.
Start with one directory and expand after confirming the structure works.
anti_patterns: Do not organize an entire home folder without exclusions.
Do not delete duplicate candidates without reviewing paths and dates.
Do not rename active project files without checking references.

faq.question: Will it delete files automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the agent to ask for confirmation before deletion.

faq.question: Can it handle duplicates?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare hashes, filenames, and sizes, then recommend which copy to keep.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it organize work and personal files separately?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks about scope and groups files by type, purpose, date, or project.

faq.question: What should I prepare first?
faq.answer: Choose a target directory, identify folders to avoid, and decide how conservative the cleanup should be.

faq.question: Is it safe for important projects?
faq.answer: Use it carefully. Back up critical data and review any move, rename, or delete plan.
